### Defining functions
```{r Making_Plotting_Function, include=FALSE, warning = FALSE, message=FALSE}
plot_stage <- function(stage_name, data, ann_colors_Pilot) {
  
  df <- data %>%
    filter(Stage == stage_name)
  
  ggplot(df, aes(x = Timepoint, y = log2CPM)) +
    
    geom_boxplot(
      aes(fill = Species, group = interaction(Timepoint, Species)),
      position = position_dodge(width = 0.8),
      alpha = 0.3,
      outlier.shape = NA
    ) +
    
    scale_fill_manual(values = ann_colors_Pilot$species_cor) +
    
    geom_jitter(
      aes(color = Individual),
      position = position_jitterdodge(
        jitter.width = 0.15,
        dodge.width = 0.8
      ),
      size = 1,
      alpha = 0.6
    ) +
    
    scale_color_manual(values = ann_colors_Pilot$individual_cor) +
    
    geom_line(
      stat = "summary",
      fun = mean,
      aes(group = Species, linetype = Species),
      position = position_dodge(width = 0.8),
      linewidth = 1
    ) +
    
    scale_linetype_manual(values = c(C = "dotted", H = "solid")) +
    
    geom_point(
      stat = "summary",
      fun = mean,
      aes(shape = Species),
      position = position_dodge(width = 0.8),
      size = 2
    ) +
    
    facet_wrap(~ Gene, scales = "free_y") +
    
    theme_classic() +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)) +
    
    ggtitle(stage_name)
}
```

```{r Setting_Up_colors, results="hide"}
  timepoint_cor = c(
    "Day0" = "#e9a3c1",
    "DayH" = "#e9a3f1",
    "Day1" = "#d81b61",
    "Day2" = "#d81b91", 
    "Day3" = "#5AAA464D", 
    "Day4" = "#5AAA469D",  
    "Day5" = "#6c4199", 
    "Day7" = "#6c6999",
    "Day10" = "#e57e67",
    "Day15" = "#e57e25",  
    "Day30" = "#9e2b2b"
```

### Boxplot_Histograms_Unfiltered
```{r RNASeq_FeatureCounts_Unfiltered, fig.height=6,fig.width=12}

####All####

RNA_fc <- readRDS("data/QC/RNA_fc.RDS")

RNA_log2cpm <- cpm(RNA_fc,log=TRUE)

col_labels <- colnames(RNA_log2cpm)

hist(RNA_log2cpm,  main = "Histogram of all counts (unfiltered)",
     xlab =expression("Log"[2]*" counts-per-million"), col =4 )

boxplot(RNA_log2cpm, main = "Boxplots of log cpm per sample
          (unfiltered)", xaxt = "n", xlab= "")
axis(1,
     at = 1:length(col_labels),  # positions (one per sample)
     labels = col_labels,        # your labels vector
     las = 2,               # rotate text vertically (like srt=90)
     cex.axis = 0.6)        # shrink label size

saveRDS(RNA_log2cpm,"data/QC/RNA_log2cpm.RDS")
```

```{r RNASeq_FeatureCounts_Unfiltered_correlation}

RNA_fc <- readRDS("data/QC/RNA_fc.RDS")
RNA_Metadata <- readRDS("data/Raw_Data/RNA_Metadata.RDS")

###### Align Metadata with RNA_log2cpm ###### 

# Match metadata rows to the order of RNA_log2cpm columns 
RNA_Metadata <- RNA_Metadata[ match(colnames(RNA_log2cpm), RNA_Metadata$SampleName), ] 

metadata <- RNA_Metadata %>% 
  filter(Timepoint != "Day30")

counts <- RNA_fc %>% 
  as.data.frame() %>% 
  dplyr::select(-contains("Day30"))

library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggsignif)

metadata <- metadata[
    match(colnames(counts), metadata$SampleName),
]


Cor_log2cpm <- readRDS("data/QC/Cor_RNA_log2cpm.RDS")


sample_info <- data.frame(
  sample    = colnames(Cor_log2cpm),
  species   = metadata$Species,
  timepoint = metadata$Timepoint
)


cor_long <- as.data.frame(Cor_log2cpm) %>%
  mutate(sample1 = rownames(Cor_log2cpm)) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    -sample1,
    names_to = "sample2",
    values_to = "cor"
  ) %>%
  filter(sample1 != sample2) %>%
  left_join(
    sample_info,
    by = c("sample1" = "sample")
  ) %>%
  dplyr::rename(
    species1 = species,
    timepoint1 = timepoint
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    sample_info,
    by = c("sample2" = "sample")
  ) %>%
  dplyr::rename(
    species2 = species,
    timepoint2 = timepoint
  )


same_day_cross <- cor_long %>%
  filter(
    species1 != species2,
    timepoint1 == timepoint2
  ) %>%
  filter(species1 == "H") %>% 
  mutate(
    timepoint1 = factor(
      timepoint1,
      levels = c("Day0","DayH","Day1","Day2","Day3","Day4","Day5","Day7","Day10","Day15","Day30")
    )
  )


# ---------------------------------------------------------
# Summary statistics
# ---------------------------------------------------------

summary_by_day <- same_day_cross %>%
  group_by(timepoint1) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_cor = mean(cor, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_cor = sd(cor, na.rm = TRUE),
    n = n()
  )

summary_by_day


# ---------------------------------------------------------
# Kruskal-Wallis test
# ---------------------------------------------------------

kruskal_res <- kruskal.test(
  cor ~ timepoint1,
  data = same_day_cross
)

kruskal_res


# ---------------------------------------------------------
# ALL pairwise Wilcoxon rank-sum tests
# ---------------------------------------------------------

library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
# install.packages("rstatix")
library(rstatix)
# install.packages("ggpubr")
library(ggpubr)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# Pairwise Wilcoxon tests with BH correction
# ---------------------------------------------------------

stat.test <- same_day_cross %>%
  pairwise_wilcox_test(
    cor ~ timepoint1,
    p.adjust.method = "BH"
  ) %>%
  add_significance("p.adj") %>% 
  add_y_position()

stat.test

# Keep only significant comparisons if desired
stat.test <- stat.test %>%
  filter(p.adj <= 0.05)


stat.test

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# Plot
# ---------------------------------------------------------

plot <- ggplot(
  same_day_cross,
  aes(
    x = timepoint1,
    y = cor,
    group = 1
  )
) +

  geom_line(
    alpha = 0.5
  ) +

  geom_point(
    alpha = 0.6,
    size = 2
  ) +

  stat_pvalue_manual(
    stat.test,
    label = "p.adj.signif",
    step.increase = 0.07
  ) +

  coord_cartesian(
    ylim = c(0.8, 1.00)
  ) +

  labs(
    title = "Cross-species (Human vs Chimp) correlation, matched timepoints \nUnfiltered",
    x = "Timepoint",
    y = "Spearman correlation"
  ) +

  theme_classic()

plot

ggsave(
  "purity_plot.pdf",
  plot = plot,
  width = 5,
  height = 5
)

```

```{r RNASeq_FeatureCounts_Unfiltered_markers, fig.height=6,fig.width=12}
RNA_fc <- readRDS("data/QC/RNA_fc.RDS")
RNA_Metadata <- readRDS("data/Raw_Data/RNA_Metadata.RDS")
marker_genes <- readRDS("data/Raw_Data/marker_genes.RDS")

RNA_log2cpm <- cpm(RNA_fc,log=TRUE)

###### Align Metadata with RNA_log2cpm ###### 

# Match metadata rows to the order of RNA_log2cpm columns 
RNA_Metadata <- RNA_Metadata[ match(colnames(RNA_log2cpm), RNA_Metadata$SampleName), ] 

metadata <- RNA_Metadata %>% 
  filter(Timepoint != "Day30")

counts <- RNA_fc %>% 
  as.data.frame() %>% 
  dplyr::select(-contains("Day30"))

RNA_log2cpm <- cpm(counts,log=TRUE)

markers <- marker_genes$Ensembl.ID

log2cpm_long <- RNA_log2cpm %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  rownames_to_column("Ensembl.ID") %>%
  filter(Ensembl.ID %in% markers) %>% 
  pivot_longer(
    cols = -Ensembl.ID,
    names_to = "Sample",
    values_to = "log2CPM"
  )

log2cpm_long <- log2cpm_long %>%
  left_join(RNA_Metadata, by = c("Sample" = "SampleName"))

log2cpm_long <- log2cpm_long %>%
  left_join(marker_genes, by = "Ensembl.ID",relationship = "many-to-many")

log2cpm_long$Timepoint <- factor(
  log2cpm_long$Timepoint,
  levels = c("Day0","DayH","Day1","Day2","Day3","Day4","Day5","Day7","Day10","Day15","Day30")
)

log2cpm_long_NoR <- log2cpm_long %>% 
  filter(Individual != "H4R")

mean_df <- log2cpm_long_NoR %>%
  group_by(Stage, Timepoint, Species) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_log2CPM = mean(log2CPM),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

log2cpm_long_NoR$Stage <- factor(
  log2cpm_long_NoR$Stage,
  levels = c(
    "Pluripotency",
    "Mesoderm",
    "CardiacProgenitors",
    "EarlyCardiomyocytes",
    "MatureCardiomyocytes"
  )
)
```

```{r RNASeq_FeatureCounts_Unfiltered_markers_heatmap2}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(tibble)

mat <- log2cpm_long_NoR %>%
  dplyr::group_by(Gene, Sample) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(log2CPM = mean(log2CPM, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%

  tibble::column_to_rownames("Gene") %>%
  as.matrix()

stage_order <- c(
  "Pluripotency",
  "Mesoderm",
  "CardiacProgenitors",
  "EarlyCardiomyocytes"
)

gene_annot_df <- log2cpm_long_NoR %>%
  dplyr::select(Gene, Stage) %>%
  distinct() %>%
  filter(Stage != "MatureCardiomyocytes", !is.na(Stage)) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(Stage = factor(Stage, levels = stage_order)) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(Stage)

# Order matrix rows and set row names properly

gene_annot <- data.frame(Stage = gene_annot_df$Stage, row.names = gene_annot_df$Gene)

tp_order <- c("Day0","DayH","Day1","Day2","Day3","Day4","Day5","Day7","Day10","Day15")

sample_annot <- log2cpm_long_NoR %>%
  distinct(Sample, Timepoint, Species) %>%
  mutate(Timepoint = factor(trimws(Timepoint), levels = tp_order)) %>%
  column_to_rownames("Sample")

# Align sample_annot to matrix columns while preserving row names
sample_annot <- sample_annot[colnames(mat), c("Timepoint", "Species"), drop = FALSE]

annotation_colors <- list(
  Timepoint = ann_colors_Pilot$timepoint_cor,
  Species   = ann_colors_Pilot$species_cor,
  Stage = c(
    Pluripotency = "#1f77b4",

    CardiacMesoderm = "yellow",
    CardiacProgenitors = "#2ca02c",
    EarlyCardiomyocytes = "#d62728"
  )
)

# Use pheatmap::pheatmap() directly with filename to avoid the S4 error
pheatmap::pheatmap(
  mat,
  annotation_col = sample_annot,
  annotation_row = gene_annot,
  annotation_colors = annotation_colors,
  cluster_rows = FALSE,
  clustering_distance_cols = "correlation",
  color = colorRampPalette(c("#2166AC", "white", "#B2182B"))(100),
  filename = path.expand("docs/pilot_marker_heatmap.pdf"),
  width = 10,
  height = 12
)
```

```{r RNASeq_FeatureCounts_lcpm_G1_HalfSpeciesTimepoints_Correlation}

Cor_log2cpm <- readRDS("data/QC/Cor_Filt_logcpm_G1_1sample_RNA_log2cpm.RDS")

H_samples <- grep("^H", colnames(Cor_log2cpm), value = TRUE)
C_samples <- grep("^C", colnames(Cor_log2cpm), value = TRUE)

H_C_cor <- expand.grid(
  H_sample = H_samples,
  C_sample = C_samples,
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

H_C_cor$Spearman <- mapply(
  function(h, c) Cor_log2cpm[h, c],
  H_C_cor$H_sample,
  H_C_cor$C_sample
)

H_C_cor$H_timepoint <- sub("^.*_(Day.*)$", "\\1", H_C_cor$H_sample)
H_C_cor$C_timepoint <- sub("^.*_(Day.*)$", "\\1", H_C_cor$C_sample)

head(H_C_cor)

  H_C_cor$H_timepoint,
  levels = timepoint_order
)

  H_C_cor$C_timepoint,
  levels = timepoint_order
)
```

```{r RNASeq_FeatureCounts_lcpm_G1_HalfSpeciesTimepoints_Correlation2}
)

H_C_cor$H_timepoint <- sub("^.*_(Day.*)$", "\\1", H_C_cor$H_sample)
H_C_cor$C_timepoint <- sub("^.*_(Day.*)$", "\\1", H_C_cor$C_sample)

head(H_C_cor)

timepoint_order <- c(
  "Day0", "DayH", "Day1", "Day2", "Day3",
  "Day4", "Day5", "Day7", "Day10", "Day15"
)

H_C_cor$H_timepoint <- factor(
  H_C_cor$H_timepoint,
  levels = timepoint_order
)

H_C_cor$C_timepoint <- factor(
  H_C_cor$C_timepoint,
  levels = timepoint_order
)


table(H_C_cor$H_timepoint, H_C_cor$C_timepoint)

library(ggplot2)

ggplot(
  subset(H_C_cor, C_timepoint == "Day0"),
  aes(x = H_timepoint, y = Spearman, group = 1)
) +
  geom_line() +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  theme_classic() +
  labs(
    x = "Human developmental timepoint",
    y = "Spearman correlation",
    title = "Chimp Day0 vs. human developmental trajectory"
  )

ggplot(
  H_C_cor,
  aes(x = H_timepoint, y = Spearman, group = C_timepoint, color = C_timepoint)
) +
  geom_line() +
  geom_point(size = 2) +
  theme_classic() +
  labs(
    x = "Human developmental timepoint",
    y = "Spearman correlation",
    color = "Chimp timepoint"
  )
```

```{r RNASeq_FeatureCounts_lcpm_G1_HalfSpeciesTimepoints_Correlation_matched}

library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggsignif)

counts <- readRDS("data/QC/Filt_logcpm_G1_1sample_RNA_fc.RDS")
metadata <- readRDS("data/Raw_Data/RNA_Metadata.RDS")

metadata <- metadata %>% 
  filter(Timepoint != "Day30")

counts <- counts %>% 
  as.data.frame() %>% 
  dplyr::select(-contains("Day30"))

# Make sure metadata follows the count matrix
metadata <- metadata[
    match(colnames(counts), metadata$SampleName),
]

metadata <- metadata %>% 
  filter(Individual != "H4R") 

counts <- counts %>% 
  dplyr::select(-contains("R"))


Cor_log2cpm <- readRDS(
  "data/QC/Cor_Filt_logcpm_G1_1sample_RNA_log2cpm.RDS"
)


sample_info <- data.frame(
  sample    = colnames(Cor_log2cpm),
  species   = metadata$Species,
  timepoint = metadata$Timepoint
)


cor_long <- as.data.frame(Cor_log2cpm) %>%
  mutate(sample1 = rownames(Cor_log2cpm)) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    -sample1,
    names_to = "sample2",
    values_to = "cor"
  ) %>%
  filter(sample1 != sample2) %>%
  left_join(
    sample_info,
    by = c("sample1" = "sample")
  ) %>%
  dplyr::rename(
    species1 = species,
    timepoint1 = timepoint
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    sample_info,
    by = c("sample2" = "sample")
  ) %>%
  dplyr::rename(
    species2 = species,
    timepoint2 = timepoint
  )

species_day_cross <- cor_long %>%
  filter(
    species1 != species2,
  ) %>%
  filter(species1 == "H") %>% 
  mutate(
    timepoint1 = factor(
      timepoint1,
      levels = c("Day0","DayH","Day1","Day2","Day3","Day4","Day5","Day7","Day10","Day15","Day30")
    )
  )

same_day_cross <- cor_long %>%
  filter(
    species1 != species2,
    timepoint1 == timepoint2
  ) %>%
  filter(species1 == "H") %>% 
  mutate(
    timepoint1 = factor(
      timepoint1,
      levels = c("Day0","DayH","Day1","Day2","Day3","Day4","Day5","Day7","Day10","Day15","Day30")
    )
  )


# ---------------------------------------------------------
# Summary statistics
# ---------------------------------------------------------

summary_by_day <- same_day_cross %>%
  group_by(timepoint1) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_cor = mean(cor, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_cor = sd(cor, na.rm = TRUE),
    n = n()
  )

summary_by_day


# ---------------------------------------------------------
# Kruskal-Wallis test
# ---------------------------------------------------------

kruskal_res <- kruskal.test(
  cor ~ timepoint1,
  data = same_day_cross
)

kruskal_res


# ---------------------------------------------------------
# ALL pairwise Wilcoxon rank-sum tests
# ---------------------------------------------------------

library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
# install.packages("rstatix")
library(rstatix)
# install.packages("ggpubr")
library(ggpubr)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# Pairwise Wilcoxon tests with BH correction
# ---------------------------------------------------------

stat.test <- same_day_cross %>%
  pairwise_wilcox_test(
    cor ~ timepoint1
  ) %>%
  add_y_position()

stat.test

# Keep only significant comparisons if desired
stat.test <- stat.test %>%
  filter(p.adj <= 0.05)


stat.test

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# Plot
# ---------------------------------------------------------

plot <- ggplot(
  same_day_cross,
  aes(
    x = timepoint1,
    y = cor,
    group = 1
  )
) +

  geom_line(
    alpha = 0.5
  ) +

  geom_point(
    alpha = 0.6,
    size = 2
  ) +

  stat_pvalue_manual(
    stat.test,
    label = "p.adj.signif",
    step.increase = 0.07
  ) +

  coord_cartesian(
    ylim = c(0.8, 1.00)
  ) +

  labs(
    title = "Cross-species (Human vs Chimp) correlation, matched timepoints \nLog2cpm >1 in at least 1 sample",
    x = "Timepoint",
    y = "Spearman correlation"
  ) +

  theme_classic()

plot

ggsave(
  "purity_plot.pdf",
  plot = plot,
  width = 5,
  height = 5
)

```
